blocks.content: **Prerequisite —** An **External Client App** in the target Salesforce org with **OAuth enabled** and **Postman's callback URL** added to the allowed callback URLs.

stepItems.content: Create a request in Postman and set the method to **POST**.
Enter the complete URL for the Pipeline or Executable operation.
Select **Get New Access Token** and log in to Salesforce.
After authentication is complete, save and use the token.
Open the **Headers** tab and add `Content-Type: application/json`.
Open the **Body** tab, select **raw › JSON**, and enter the request body if needed.
